title: Sales pulse
intent: Alert when revenue changes materially versus the previous comparable period. Inspect related dashboard charts before routing. Ignore expected seasonal movement. Notify revenue operations only when the evidence supports action.
investigation_hints: Compare total revenue with the time-grained revenue chart.
Check whether the movement is concentrated in one product line.
Do not notify when the dashboard has no comparable baseline.
materiality_definition: Treat a movement as material when it is large enough to affect the operating decision, is not explained by an expected seasonal pattern, and is supported by a related chart.

outcome_guidance.ignore: No owner action is needed because the movement is expected or not decision-relevant.
outcome_guidance.investigate: Ask a human or downstream workflow to inspect an ambiguous or incomplete signal.
outcome_guidance.notify: Send a non-urgent message to the approved operating owner.
outcome_guidance.escalate: Send an urgent message when the data is untrustworthy or the impact is severe.
